lines: FAB SHARE Credit Cards - Mall Rewards & Cashback | FAB UAE
Earn more SHARE points and enjoy incredible card benefits.
Welcome to the world of SHARE, get ready for more.
Shop, dine, experience, and discover the many benefits and rewards that SHARE has to offer. You’ll earn as you go and be able to redeem your points on just about anything.

As a SHARE member, you can earn value back in SHARE points for all your shopping, dining and fun. Collect points across thousands of participating stores, restaurants and attractions, and then use them to pay for your purchases and experiences. You’ll also enjoy exclusive SHARE member benefits as well as regular special offers, discounts and contest opportunities that you can enjoy.

Earn points on your purchases at all 5,000+ stores, restaurants and experiences at Mall of the Emirates and City Centres in the UAE. SHARE also works at all VOX Cinemas, Carrefour locations and hotel restaurants in the malls.

Redeem your SHARE points for any of your purchases at Mall of the Emirates and City Centres across the UAE and Majid Al Futtaim brands. You can pay with your SHARE points or a combination of cash and points.
